title: Download 即梦AI Dreamina China to access Seedance 2.0 fast (Seedance 2.0 fast is…
content:
Download 即梦AI Dreamina China to access Seedance 2.0 fast (Seedance 2.0 fast is the only Seedance option available there right now).  
Download 小云雀 (Xiao Yunque / Little Skylark) to access Seedance 2.0.  
Install these apps via Tencent MyApp (应用宝 / Yingyong Bao) to get the official downloads.  
Use a Douyin (抖音) account to log in (create one if needed; it accepts international phone numbers) to get access with no waitlist and free daily generations.  
On Huawei/EMUI/Android, use these apps to get more generations per day.
